mapper.select: select c.id, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.industry_name, c.customer_type, c.customer_level, c.risk_level as customer_risk_level, c.blacklist_flag, c.status as customer_status, c.owner_org_name, c.relationship_manager_name, ifnull(r.rating_no, '') as rating_no, r.rating_level, r.rating_date, ifnull(l.limit_no, '') as limit_no, ifnull(l.total_limit_amount, 0) as total_limit_amount, ifnull(l.used_limit_amount, 0) as used_limit_amount, ifnull(l.available_limit_amount, 0) as available_limit_amount, ifnull(l.limit_status, '') as limit_status, ifnull(app.application_count, 0) as application_count, ifnull(app.application_amount_total, 0) as application_amount_total, ifnull(ct.contract_count, 0) as contract_count, ifnull(ct.contract_amount_total, 0) as contract_amount_total, ifnull(dr.drawdown_count, 0) as drawdown_count, ifnull(dr.actual_draw_amount_total, 0) as actual_draw_amount_total, ifnull(dr.outstanding_principal_amount_total, 0) as outstanding_principal_amount_total, ifnull(co.collateral_count, 0) as collateral_count, ifnull(co.confirmed_value_total, 0) as confirmed_value_total, ifnull(rel.total_secured_amount, 0) as total_secured_amount, ifnull(ex.exposure_count, 0) as exposure_count, ifnull(ex.ead_amount_total, 0) as ead_amount_total, ifnull(ex.el_avg_total, 0) as el_avg_total, ifnull(ex.max_pd, 0) as max_pd, ifnull(ex.max_lgd_avg, 0) as max_lgd_avg, ifnull(ex.max_lgd_downturn, 0) as max_lgd_downturn, ifnull(ov.overdue_count, 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(ov.max_overdue_days, 0) as max_overdue_days, ifnull(ov.overdue_amount_total, 0) as overdue_amount_total, ifnull(dd.debt_default_count, 0) as debt_default_count, ifnull(dd.default_exposure_amount_total, 0) as default_exposure_amount_total, case dd.highest_default_rank when 1 then 'A' when 2 then 'B' when 3 then 'C' else '' end as highest_default_level, ifnull(cd.customer_default_no, '') as customer_default_no, ifnull(cd.default_status, '') as customer_default_status, ifnull(cd.total_default_debt_count, 0) as customer_default_total_debt_count from corporate_customer c left join corporate_rating r on r.active_customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_credit_limit l on l.active_customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no_snapshot as customer_no, count(*) as application_count, sum(apply_amount) as application_amount_total from corporate_credit_application where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) app on app.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no_snapshot as customer_no, count(*) as contract_count, sum(contract_amount) as contract_amount_total from corporate_credit_contract where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) ct on ct.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no_snapshot as customer_no, count(*) as drawdown_count, sum(actual_draw_amount) as actual_draw_amount_total, sum(outstanding_principal_amount) as outstanding_principal_amount_total from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no_snapshot ) dr on dr.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as collateral_count, sum(confirmed_value) as confirmed_value_total from corporate_credit_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) co on co.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, sum(secured_amount) as total_secured_amount from corporate_credit_contract_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 and relation_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) rel on rel.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as exposure_count, sum(ead_amount) as ead_amount_total, sum(el_avg) as el_avg_total, max(pd) as max_pd, max(lgd_avg) as max_lgd_avg, max(lgd_downturn) as max_lgd_downturn from corporate_risk_exposure where deleted_flag = 0 and exposure_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) ex on ex.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as overdue_count, max(overdue_days) as max_overdue_days, sum(total_overdue_amount) as overdue_amount_total from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 group by customer_no ) ov on ov.customer_no = c.customer_no left join ( select customer_no, count(*) as debt_default_count, sum(default_exposure_amount) as default_exposure_amount_total, min(case default_level when 'A' then 1 when 'B' then 2 when 'C' then 3 else 9 end) as highest_default_rank from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and default_status = 'ACTIVE' group by customer_no ) dd on dd.customer_no = c.customer_no left join corporate_customer_default cd on cd.active_customer_no = c.customer_no where c.deleted_flag = 0 and ( c.customer_no = #{customer} or c.customer_name = #{customer} or c.customer_no like concat('%', #{customer}, '%') or c.customer_name like concat('%', #{customer}, '%') ) order by case when c.customer_no = #{customer} then 1 when c.customer_name = #{customer} then 2 else 3 end, c.customer_no limit 1

select debt_default_no, contract_no, debt_no, default_level, default_date, overdue_days, default_exposure_amount, loss_amount, default_status from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} order by default_date desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select overdue_no, contract_no, debt_no, overdue_date, overdue_days, grace_due_date, legal_holiday_flag, total_overdue_amount, remaining_overdue_amount, repayment_status, collection_status from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} order by overdue_date desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select contract_no, contract_name, product_type, contract_amount, used_draw_amount, available_draw_amount, sign_date, effective_date, expiry_date, contract_status from corporate_credit_contract where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} order by effective_date desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select co.collateral_no, co.collateral_name, co.collateral_type, co.confirmed_value, co.available_secured_amount, co.collateral_status, ifnull(rel.contract_count, 0) as related_contract_count, ifnull(rel.secured_amount_total, 0) as secured_amount_total from corporate_credit_collateral co left join ( select collateral_no, count(*) as contract_count, sum(secured_amount) as secured_amount_total from corporate_credit_contract_collateral where deleted_flag = 0 and relation_status = 'ACTIVE' group by collateral_no ) rel on rel.collateral_no = co.collateral_no where co.deleted_flag = 0 and co.customer_no = #{customerNo} order by co.confirmed_value desc, co.id desc limit #{limit}

select event_date, event_type, event_title, event_detail, risk_marker from ( select date(submitted_at) as event_date, '业务申请' as event_type, application_no as event_title, concat(product_type, '，申请金额 ', format(apply_amount, 2), '，状态 ', application_status) as event_detail, '业务申请' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_application where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} and submitted_at is not null union all select effective_date as event_date, '合同生效' as event_type, contract_no as event_title, concat(product_type, '，合同金额 ', format(contract_amount, 2), '，状态 ', contract_status) as event_detail, '合同' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_contract where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} union all select drawdown_date as event_date, '债项支用' as event_type, drawdown_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', ifnull(debt_no, '-'), '，支用金额 ', format(actual_draw_amount, 2), '，未结本金 ', format(outstanding_principal_amount, 2)) as event_detail, '债项' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} union all select overdue_date as event_date, '逾期预警' as event_type, overdue_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', debt_no, '，逾期 ', overdue_days, ' 天，逾期金额 ', format(total_overdue_amount, 2)) as event_detail, '逾期' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} union all select default_date as event_date, '债项违约' as event_type, debt_default_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', debt_no, '，违约等级 ', default_level, '，违约敞口 ', format(default_exposure_amount, 2)) as event_detail, concat('违约 ', default_level) as risk_marker from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} ) customer_events where event_date is not null order by event_date desc, event_type limit #{limit}

select event_date, event_type, event_title, event_detail, risk_marker from ( select date(submitted_at) as event_date, 10 as event_sequence, '业务申请' as event_type, application_no as event_title, concat(product_type, '，申请金额 ', format(apply_amount, 2), '，状态 ', application_status) as event_detail, '业务申请' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_application where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} and submitted_at is not null union all select coalesce(effective_date, sign_date) as event_date, 20 as event_sequence, '合同生效' as event_type, contract_no as event_title, concat(product_type, '，合同金额 ', format(contract_amount, 2), '，状态 ', contract_status) as event_detail, '合同' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_contract where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} union all select drawdown_date as event_date, 30 as event_sequence, '债项支用' as event_type, drawdown_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', ifnull(debt_no, '-'), '，支用金额 ', format(actual_draw_amount, 2), '，未结本金 ', format(outstanding_principal_amount, 2)) as event_detail, '债项' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_drawdown where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} union all select overdue_date as event_date, 40 as event_sequence, '债项逾期' as event_type, overdue_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', debt_no, '，逾期 ', overdue_days, ' 天，逾期金额 ', format(total_overdue_amount, 2)) as event_detail, '逾期' as risk_marker from corporate_credit_overdue where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} union all select default_date as event_date, 50 as event_sequence, '债项违约' as event_type, debt_default_no as event_title, concat('债项 ', debt_no, '，违约等级 ', default_level, '，违约敞口 ', format(default_exposure_amount, 2)) as event_detail, concat('违约 ', default_level) as risk_marker from corporate_debt_default where deleted_flag = 0 and customer_no = #{customerNo} ) customer_events where event_date is not null order by event_date, event_sequence, event_title limit #{limit}
